_comment: DECLARED, not BUNDLED. No model weights or third-party runtimes ship in this cut. Every adapter is core_tier_influence=NO: external activity predictions never change ab_score/af_score/ab_recall/af_recall/lead tier/the sealed triage board. Predicted activity is not measured activity. Per the Developer or User's v9.7.348 verdict (2026-08-02).
governance: interface/schema only; experimental, non-scoring contract; not an operational feature

adapters.family: RF / SVM / logistic ensemble over antiSMASH Pfam/smCOG/CDS-motif + optional CARD-RGI
caveats: joblib load only from hashed source

adapters.runnable_now: no (legacy Py/TF env obsolete; reimplement with current libs + versioned training ledger)

adapters.family: neural net over 1131 features (715 Pfam + 16 nt k-mer + 400 protein / first-50-CDS)
adapters.runnable_now: no (predictions non-admissible: rows must be OUT_OF_DOMAIN/FAILED)
caveats: released fc1/layer1 computed then discarded (perturbation delta 0.0, no gradients)
checked-in BGC0000004 example does not reproduce (antibacterial 1->0)
HC is a display subset of ORG, not a stronger threshold

adapters.family: transformer masked-LM, multi-label sigmoid, 6 bioactivity outputs
adapters.architecture: vocab 7204 / d_model 768 / 2 layers / 6 outputs; both transformer layers used; strict-load clean; 7204-token vocab reconstructed from 897008 public training records
adapters.runnable_now: reproducibly loads/runs, but NOT for AB/AF prioritization
caveats: padding-sensitive: probability delta up to 0.653 on short/fragment BGCs
public release omits some parameters + calibrated thresholds
contig_edge=True regions omitted; over-length handling inconsistent

adapters.runnable_now: no (do not bundle or automate the web service; ingest user-supplied results only)
caveats: record structure-confidence + whether AB/AF came from predicted structure vs Pfam baseline
